thread:
maria: WIP — I pushed an initial dashboard for prefix/prompt-cache hit-rates. Shows per-model, per-route, per-customer hit_rate, token_saved, and traffic-weighted hit_rate. Please poke around: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/uxc1 :eyes:
sam: Nice, saw it. Quick question — is the cache key including model_version and route? I see some dupes across routes.
jon: UI looks good. Can we also show rolling 1h / 24h windows + percentile? perf team needs to correlate with kernel selection changes.
maria: Yep — added 1h/24h/7d toggles. Also added `percentile(hit_rate, 50/90)` panels.
eva: What's warmup strategy? Are we prepopulating KV for common prompts or relying on opportunistic warmup?
maria: For now opportunistic + on-demand async warmup worker. Plan: nightly warmup job seeded from hottest prompts for each customer-route-model pair. TTL currently 12h (config: `prefix_cache.ttl=12h`).
sam: Observed a regression on canary after the new kernel selection: model mv3 canary hit_rate dropped 62% -> 8% around the same time. Anyone else see that? :warning:
jon: I traced it — kernel changed tokenization boundary for same prompts so fingerprint differs. We need normalization step before fingerprinting.
maria: Good catch. Short-term mitigation: add `prompt_normalizer.v1` to keying before `prompt_fingerprint`. Long-term: adjust tokenizer/kernel interface so same logical prompt maps to same fingerprint.
eva: Also surface `prefix_cache.miss_reason` tag (e.g. `expired/evicted/unknown/fingerprint_mismatch`) — that'll help triage.
maria: Added `miss_reason` sparingly (only on sampled misses) to avoid cardinality blowup. Prometheus metrics exposed:
```
prefix_cache.hits_total
prefix_cache.misses_total
prefix_cache.tokens_saved_total
prefix_cache.evictions_total
prefix_cache.miss_reason_sampled{reason=\"fingerprint_mismatch\"}
```
sam: Can you drop example PromQL for hit rate + tokens saved?
maria: Sure — paste:
```
# hit rate (1h)
(sum by(model,route)(increase(prefix_cache.hits_total[1h])) / (sum by(model,route)(increase(prefix_cache.hits_total[1h]) + increase(prefix_cache.misses_total[1h])))) * 100
# tokens saved per minute (1h)
sum by(model,route)(increase(prefix_cache.tokens_saved_total[1h])) / 60
```
obs-bot: alert prefix_cache_drop: model=mv3 region=us-west dropped below 15% hit rate (1h) at 2026-06-12T15:02:01Z
jon: For observability, can we add a "token-saved ROI" panel = tokens_saved / cpu_tokens_used_by_miss? would help cost decisions.
maria: Agree. I'll compute `token_saving_per_cpu_ms` in the backend and add panel. Also adding per-customer sortable table with top customers by tokens_saved and hit_rate to prioritize warmup.
sam: One more — for privacy, make sure sampled miss payloads are redacted before shipping to S3. @eva can you add guardrails?
eva: Will add redaction lambda + IAM policy. We'll sample <0.1% of misses by default.
maria: OK schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to triage the mv3 canary and finalize dashboards. PT 10am? :calendar:
sam: +1
jon: +1
